facts.fact: Document says the Horizon Fiber project, announced in February 2026, is a terrestrial link of nearly 2,800 km extending Djibouti's connectivity into the Horn of Africa; it names no other country and gives no date beyond the announcement.

note: Names no other country at the link's ends; the fact rests on the February 2026 announcement. EARDIP and the 14 submarine cables are not described as joining African countries.
